_instructions: This JSON file defines all infrastructure components, IP addresses, domains, common services, core microservices, and failover procedure steps. Engineers can update any value here to reflect live changes.

oracleDatabases.name: cbdc-rtsp-db
oracleDatabases.description: Stores e-Rupee wallets, transaction ledgers, and token serial numbers

oracleDatabases.name: cbdc-mint-db
oracleDatabases.description: Stores RBI minting authorizations, token serial keys, and audit logs

failoverSteps.title: Enable Maintenance Mode
failoverSteps.action: Enable Maintenance Mode in Web for Both Sites
failoverSteps.details: Displays maintenance banner to end users on erupeeapp.sbi.bank.in and merchanterupee.sbi.bank.in to prevent in-flight transactions.
failoverSteps.log: [STEP 1/11] Executing Web Maintenance Mode toggle on WAF-PR-252 and WAF-DR-230... Response: HTTP 503 Maintenance Enabled.

failoverSteps.title: Point Public DNS
failoverSteps.action: Point DNS to target site IP
failoverSteps.details: Update public A-records for erupeeapp.sbi.bank.in and merchanterupee.sbi.bank.in to target site WAF IP.
failoverSteps.log: [STEP 2/11] Updating DNS A-Record target to Target Site WAF IP... TTL set to 60s. DNS Propagation initialized.

failoverSteps.title: Stop PLB at Source Site
failoverSteps.details: Drains existing HTTP connections on Public Load Balancer at source site to ensure zero pending requests.
failoverSteps.log: [STEP 3/11] Gracefully stopping PLB listener on Source Site... 0 active client sockets remaining.

failoverSteps.title: Update Internal DNS
failoverSteps.action: Update DNS of internal DNS point to target site
failoverSteps.details: Update internal routing tables so backend services route to target site ILB (cbdc-ilb.bank.sbi).
failoverSteps.log: [STEP 4/11] Modifying Internal PrivateZone DNS mapping to Target ILB IP... Reloaded ad.sbi zones.

failoverSteps.title: Stop All App Services
failoverSteps.action: Stop All Services on Source Site
failoverSteps.details: Halts RTSP application pods, minting engine worker threads, and event consumers.
failoverSteps.log: [STEP 5/11] Sending SIGTERM to RTSP Core, Minting SVC, and Kafka consumers on Source App VMs... All stopped.

failoverSteps.title: Switch Database (Failover/Switchover)
failoverSteps.action: Switch Database from DR to PR / PR to DR
failoverSteps.details: Executes Oracle Data Guard / GoldenGate role switchover. Promotes standby database to Read-Write and demotes primary to Read-Only standby.
failoverSteps.log: [STEP 6/11] Executing Oracle Data Guard Switchover: ALTER DATABASE SWITCHOVER TO PRIMARY... Applied redo logs. Database mode: READ WRITE.

failoverSteps.title: Update DB Configuration
failoverSteps.details: Updates active site flag, IP parameters, and callback endpoints in sysconfig tables.
failoverSteps.log: [STEP 7/11] SQL EXEC: UPDATE sysconfig SET active_site = :target_site WHERE status = 1; 24 rows updated.

failoverSteps.title: Start All App Services
failoverSteps.action: Start All Services on Target Site
failoverSteps.details: Launches application processes, initialises DB connection pools, and connects to common services (Kafka, ABAS, UPI, SMS).
failoverSteps.log: [STEP 8/11] Starting microservices on Target Site... RTSP Core: RUNNING, Mint SVC: RUNNING, Kafka Consumer: LISTENING.

failoverSteps.title: Start ILB & PLB Services
failoverSteps.details: Enables backend target groups on Internal and Public Load Balancers.
failoverSteps.log: [STEP 9/11] Enabling health check probes on Target PLB & ILB... All targets HEALTHY (200 OK).

failoverSteps.title: Check Inward Transactions
failoverSteps.details: Executes automated smoke tests for UPI inbound processing, SMS gateway dispatch, and database write integrity.
failoverSteps.log: [STEP 10/11] Synthetic test execution: Test Txn #990421 PASSED. End-to-end latency: 42ms.

failoverSteps.title: Disable Maintenance Mode
failoverSteps.action: Disable Maintenance Mode and allow traffic
failoverSteps.details: Clears maintenance page on WAF. Full public traffic active on target site.
failoverSteps.log: [STEP 11/11] Clearing Maintenance Mode on Target WAF... Live public traffic routing ACTIVE. Switchover Complete!
